universal_lens: The mapping of kinematic inputs to categorical outcomes is formalized via a multivariate affine transformation. By minimizing the squared Euclidean distance between observed whiffs and predicted probabilities, we establish a continuous metric space where spin efficiency and velocity define orthogonal axes of batter failure. Statistical inference of spin rate and velocity effects on whiff rates via multivariate regression and 3D visualization.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal inference over the multivariate regression residuals to generate dynamic prediction intervals for whiff probability. Bayesian priors are constructed from historical Statcast distributions, updating posterior densities as new pitch-level telemetry arrives, ensuring robust uncertainty quantification across varying stadium environments. Bayesian updating of pitch effectiveness using empirical distributions of spin rate and velocity as probabilistic inputs to whiff rate prediction models.
gse_mapping: In GSE, the regression coefficients act as state-transition weights within a Markov Decision Process. The engine evaluates optimal pitch sequencing by maximizing the expected value of the derived whiff function, dynamically adjusting velocity-spin tradeoffs based on real-time count states and specific batter weaknesses. Situationally adaptive pitch selection logic based on real-time spin rate and velocity optimization maps for maximizing whiff probability per pitch type.
